coverage.notes: This case verifies gallery detail fetch, save update, and delete on the standard local-e2e lane. Upload is intentionally excluded from both setup and assertions.

preconditions: The seeded standard user can sign in on the local-e2e frontend.
Playwright can start the frontend and backend webServer pair for local-e2e.
The backend gallery runtime recovery migration has been applied to the local database.
assertions: The gallery detail modal fetches the asset detail successfully.
Saving updated gallery title and description returns 200 and updates the visible card state.
Deleting the same asset returns 204 and removes it from the visible gallery list.
notes: Pilot local-e2e migration target for FE-G5 detail/save/delete after gallery runtime smoke passes.
